properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.access-key
properties.description: The access key of the Event Grid topic, for credentialType ACCESS_KEY. The azureKeyCredential option replaces it, and it is not used when the tokenCredential option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.azure-key-credential
properties.description: The access key of the Event Grid topic as a com.azure.core.credential.AzureKeyCredential, for credentialType ACCESS_KEY. It replaces the accessKey option, and it is not used when the tokenCredential option is set. The option is a com.azure.core.credential.AzureKeyCredential type.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.configuration
properties.description: The configuration that the endpoints of this component start from. Each endpoint gets a copy of it, and the options of the endpoint replace its values. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.azure.eventgrid.EventGridConfiguration type.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.credential-type
properties.description: How the producer authenticates: ACCESS_KEY with the azureKeyCredential or accessKey option, TOKEN_CREDENTIAL with the tokenCredential option, or AZURE_IDENTITY with a DefaultAzureCredential of the Azure Identity library. When one of these credential options is set, the component chooses the type from it, so set this option only for AZURE_IDENTITY.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the azure-eventgrid component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.publisher-client
properties.description: To use a custom com.azure.messaging.eventgrid.EventGridPublisherClient for CloudEvents. When it is set or autowired, the topicEndpoint and the credential options are not used. The option is a com.azure.messaging.eventgrid.EventGridPublisherClient<com.azure.core.models.CloudEvent> type.

properties.name: camel.component.azure-eventgrid.token-credential
properties.description: The com.azure.core.credential.TokenCredential that authenticates the producer with Microsoft Entra ID. When it is set, the accessKey and azureKeyCredential options are not used. The option is a com.azure.core.credential.TokenCredential type.
